title: Sanity restored
body:
In this age of AI bloat and features over purpose, Google Keep remains one of those few apps that remain simple and clean—a complete product.

However, I fear that the reason why this app stayed true to its core values is simply because Google hasn’t turned its AI evangelism onto it yet.

Google, please, keep your Gemini nonsense out of Keep and keep it clean and simple.

title: If you don't intent to lose notes, don't use this
body:
It would deserve more stars, because this app is actually really great for a lot of things. Making memos, writing stories, thoughts, sketching ideas.. but..

It has one fatal flaw. You don't store these notes on your phone. I believed I did. But then I had to change account password on different phone that used the same account. 

Google Keep wouldn't let me log in if I didn't connect to internet. When I did, I had to login and that's when I discovered I lost all my notes from past few days that were quite long.

No way to recover, nothing. Just because password was changed it didn't let me see MY notes created on MY phone.

If you want reliable way to write notes, use paper or keep looking for something different.
